item.title: Canada removes Syria from list of foreign state supporters of terrorism
item.description: Ottawa said it has also removed Hayat Tahrir al-Sham (HTS), the group that led a rebel takeover last year, from its list of terrorist entities under the Criminal Code.

item.title: Canada proposes keeping Nunavut fishing licences with non-Inuit organization
item.description: The Department of Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) is looking at reissuing fishing licences off Nunavut's coast to non-Inuit operations, despite a federal court judge saying the initial decision by Ottawa was unreasonable.

item.title: Top court restores conviction of woman who tried to kill mother with insulin injection
